mechanism.summary: T072: share a short-lived receiver/storage view and consume-once live data-slot proof across named cache validation, handler dispatch and storage lookup. Resolve cache-installation metadata from the same lookup; retain weak identities, live values, descriptor checks, layout invalidation and exotic fallbacks. Select T068 development programs whose named-cache plus named-other exclusive self fraction exceeds the equal-program mean 8.844 percent; never select from held-out. T022 overall-first is prospective: development, external, equal-case portfolio and held-out are overall gates; lane ceilings, individual sentinels/microbenchmarks and RSS are local gates, fully reported for lead judgment. Correctness and zero Test262 gaps are never waived. Peak RSS uses >=15 alternating pairs, per-case median <=1.10 and development geomean <=1.05, with T067 derived host resource manifest. Quick triage precedes every screen; require target wall geomean <=0.97 and correctness. Stop after two honest designs miss this threshold. The lead alone decides promotion.
mechanism.generality: Admission depends on ordinary receiver kind, actual live storage/slot, descriptor flags, receiver/holder identity and revisions, shared literal shape or interned stored-key identity. A borrow is scoped to one get/set/method read and ends before any user code; no retained raw pointer, source/bytecode template, benchmark-specific case, new dependency, unsafe or environment/binding rewrite. Arrays, Functions, primitives and exotic receivers preserve their own-property/prototype precedence and fallback.
semantic_risks: No cache or property RefCell borrow may cross getter/setter calls, Proxy traps, coercion, callbacks or any other user code, including reentrant reads/writes through the same instruction site.

A live slot must retain its storage borrow; identity/layout/shape/key validation and value read/write belong to the same operation. Descriptor replacement, deletion, swap removal, small/dynamic/literal conversion and namespace/typed-array behavior must invalidate or decline.
Prototype and grandprototype answers require receiver own-miss plus current chain identity and holder layout. Negative proofs are receiver/layout specific; no T065 unsound memo.
Writes preserve writability, strict/sloppy completion, accessors, global binding mirrors, globalThis intrinsic capture and nonextensibility. Cache entries own only weak receivers/values as before.

Previous property shortcuts failed portfolio screens (T041/T049/T053). Preserve existing hot paths where possible and inspect instruction-sensitive controls; no post-result layout fishing. At most two K=6 attempts; 30-block formal and 30-pair held-out only after promising triage and screen.
